title: Raids & Patrols
description: Mod to control the spawn of Pillager Raids and Patrols by config. No more of them or more difficult? [New mechanics will be added soon]
body:
Tired of founding Pillager Patrols right inside your base? You want to loot a good village without worrying about the Pillager Raids?
**This is the Mod for You!**

**Raids & Patrols** is a mod that concerne the mechanics about the spawn of pillagers.

- Right now you can choose to deactivate the spawn of raids or patrols by config (file or mod menu):
![Config Menu](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b36858bb8dd664710d5ef67cb1818ad5a831b53c_0.webp)
[Config Menu is now avaible only in NeoForge]
  
- In the future versions we want to add other feature to improve the raids and the patrols if you want to keep them active (like default).
  
- This mod is still beeing tested, if you have any issue please leave a comment and we'll try to fix it right away.
